findings.source_quote: It is said that it was his encounter with God at the bedside of that dying man that prompted Lyte’s noble hymn, “Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted hymn title into Swedish (preserving it as a quoted substantive prose). For example: ”Jesus, jag har tagit mitt kors.” Insert the translated title in place of the English title, retaining punctuation and quotes.
